title: SeoLead (ProNaiti) — Getting Started
text:
June 2022 — December 2023

This was my first professional experience in web development, where I built a solid foundation and understood how real projects work. I worked on layout and WordPress development — from simple landing pages to more complex pages with custom logic.

I used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, learned to write clean and readable code, navigate existing codebases, and handle real-world tasks. I also created custom themes and started to understand WordPress architecture.

The team was small but very supportive — always ready to help and explain. During this time, we built dozens of websites, and this is where I truly felt confident entering the profession. 🚀

title: Silver Duck — Growth & Complex Tasks
text:
March 2024 — October 2024

At this stage, the tasks became significantly more complex. I continued working with WordPress, but with deeper customization: hooks, filters, REST API, working with WP_Query and metadata.

I was involved in developing e-commerce solutions using WooCommerce, implementing custom business logic and non-standard user scenarios.

I significantly improved my understanding of project architecture and started focusing more on scalability and reusable components. The team was strong, and I learned a lot from them — it gave me a serious boost in my development. 💪

title: 808 GROUP — Advanced Level
text:
February 2025 — Present

Here I work on more complex and high-load projects. My main focus is developing and maintaining corporate websites with integrations of external APIs and services.

I work with AJAX, dynamic interfaces, data synchronization, and performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, caching, high-load preparation).

I now pay much more attention to code quality, project structure, and user experience. The projects are larger, the challenges are more interesting, and the team is highly professional. At this point, I feel confident as a developer and continue to grow further. 🔥
